**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We believe people will keep finding new ways to contribute—and we’re ready to help shape that future.

2. We’re convinced: if superintelligent AI arrives within 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. The future of work is ours to build, and we’re working toward one where people can thrive.

3. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will create more jobs than it eliminates. We’re committed to making sure people have the tools and opportunities to take part in the new work ahead.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. That future won’t happen by accident: it will take people who are ready to learn, adapt, build, and open doors for others. We’re focused on helping make that possible. As AI transforms how work gets done, new needs, industries, and opportunities will emerge—and people will be central to meeting them. We’re here to champion practical ways to prepare for change, expand access to opportunity, and ensure more people can share in the benefits. The future of work is not something we simply await; together, we’re helping create it.
